title: Overconfident model candidate is rejected when it lacks valid citations
learning_goal: Reject LLM candidate signals that claim ownership or readiness without deterministic evidence.

user_answer.text: This case evaluates a recorded LLM fixture response, not a learner answer.

candidate_signals.claim: The learner is ready to own readiness reporting end to end.
Readiness reports do not need evidence indexes when confidence is high.

expected_layer.label: Fluent Ownership
expected_layer.rationale: The fixture asserts L5 ownership, but deterministic validation must reject the claim because evidence is forbidden or missing.

expected_gap.reason: Overconfident uncited or forbidden model claims are not accepted as truth.

expected_misconception.label: LLM decides readiness
expected_misconception.reason: The fixture treats model confidence as sufficient proof of readiness.

required_evidence.expectation: Allowed evidence must show accepted readiness claims require evidence ids.

required_evidence.range: unsupported claim rejection or evidence assertion
required_evidence.expectation: Allowed evidence should demonstrate deterministic citation checks.

forbidden_evidence.reason: Explicitly excluded from the artifact boundary.

validation_notes: This case is offline-replayable and requires no live model call.
It prepares F09/E03 to reject model candidate signals unless deterministic boundary and evidence validation passes.
